name: Git Workbench
description: Explore and operate on branches, tags, remotes, commit topology, working changes, and focused diffs beside a task.

permissions.reason: Read repository references, history, status, and diffs for the selected task workspace.
Initialize a repository or run explicit Git actions such as stage, commit, fetch, pull, push, branch, merge, tag, stash, cherry-pick, and revert in the selected workspace.
Reveal a user-selected repository file or its nearest existing folder in the operating system file browser.
